mapper.sql: job.attendance_report_export_id AS export_id, job.principal_id, job.report_type, job.period_start, job.company_id, job.organization_id, job.employee_id, job.filter_status, job.purpose, job.projection_version, job.authorization_digest, job.query_fingerprint, job.visible_content_digest, job.formula_version, job.export_fields_json, job.row_count, job.delivery_mode, job.status, job.content_type, job.file_extension, job.content_sha256, job.content_length, job.failure_code, job.expires_at, job.created_at, job.completed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_report_export_job ( attendance_report_export_id, principal_id, report_type, period_start, company_id, organization_id, employee_id, filter_status, purpose, projection_version, authorization_digest, query_fingerprint, visible_content_digest, formula_version, export_fields_json, row_count, delivery_mode, status, content_type, file_extension, content_sha256, content_length, failure_code, expires_at, created_at, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{exportId}, #{principalId}, #{reportType}, #{periodStart}, #{companyId}, #{organizationId}, #{employeeId}, #{filterStatus}, #{purpose}, #{projectionVersion}, #{authorizationDigest}, #{queryFingerprint}, #{visibleContentDigest}, #{formulaVersion}, #{exportFieldsJson}, #{rowCount}, #{deliveryMode}, #{status}, #{contentType}, #{fileExtension}, #{contentSha256}, #{contentLength}, #{failureCode}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{completedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT , NULL AS content FROM attendance_report_export_job job WHERE job.status = 'QUEUED' AND job.delivery_mode = 'ASYNC' AND job.expires_at > #{claimedAt} ORDER BY job.created_at, job.attendance_report_export_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_report_export_job SET status = 'BUILDING', claimed_at = #{claimedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE attendance_report_export_id = #{exportId} AND status = 'QUEUED' AND delivery_mode = 'ASYNC' AND expires_at > #{claimedAt}

UPDATE attendance_report_export_job SET status = 'READY', content_type = #{contentType}, file_extension = #{fileExtension}, content_sha256 = #{contentSha256}, content_length = #{contentLength}, failure_code = NULL, completed_at = #{completedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE attendance_report_export_id = #{exportId} AND status = 'BUILDING' AND delivery_mode = 'ASYNC' AND visible_content_digest = #{expectedVisibleContentDigest} AND expires_at > #{completedAt}

UPDATE attendance_report_export_job SET status = 'FAILED', content_type = NULL, file_extension = NULL, content_sha256 = NULL, content_length = 0, failure_code = #{failureCode}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE attendance_report_export_id = #{exportId} AND status = 'BUILDING' AND delivery_mode = 'ASYNC'
